title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to Aameen, a privacy-focused cloud storage service. By creating an account or using Aameen, you agree to the following terms.

about.title: 1. About Aameen
content: Aameen is a secure cloud storage service that allows users to store, organize, and share files online.
Our platform uses end-to-end encryption, which means files are encrypted on your device before they are uploaded.
Only you can access your files.

account.title: 2. Your Account
account.intro: To use Aameen, you must create an account.
items: All activity that occurs under your account
account.outro: You must provide accurate information when creating an account.

encryption.title: 3. Important: Encryption & Recovery Key
encryption.intro: Aameen uses a zero-knowledge encryption system.
items: Your files are encrypted on your device before upload
The encryption keys are controlled by you
Aameen cannot access or decrypt your files
encryption.recovery: During account setup, you may receive a Recovery Key.
warningText: If you lose your password and your recovery key, your encrypted files cannot be recovered.
Aameen does not have the ability to restore or unlock your encrypted data.

data.title: 4. Your Data
data.ownership: You retain full ownership of all files and content you upload.
data.grant: By using Aameen, you grant us permission only to:
items: Process them to provide the service
data.privacy: Aameen does not view, analyze, or access your files.

acceptable.title: 5. Acceptable Use
acceptable.intro: You agree not to use Aameen for:
items: Activities that abuse or disrupt the service
acceptable.outro: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.

storage.title: 6. Storage Limits
content: Accounts may have storage limits depending on the service plan.
If your storage limit is reached, you may not be able to upload additional files until space is available.

deletion.title: 7. Account Deletion
deletion.intro: You may delete your account at any time.
items: All files and data associated with the account are permanently removed

availability.title: 8. Service Availability
availability.content: We aim to provide a reliable and secure service, but Aameen is provided "as is". We cannot guarantee that the service will always be available or uninterrupted.

changes.title: 9. Changes to These Terms
content: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time.
If significant changes are made, we will notify users through the service or by email.
